messages:
sophia: RFC follow-up: propose 'connector-lite' placement inside customer VPCs for incremental cutover. want to surface edge cases before canary.
jordan: agreed on incremental. quick thought: how will we avoid accidental route import of wider CIDRs?
kai: enforce strict prefix-allowlist on BGP/route advertisements. only advertise cp-specific /24s; deny everything else.
jordan: also consider asymmetric path issues: some tenants expect customer-firewall to see original src IP. preserve-src preferred but cloud limits sometimes force SNAT. we need a clear fallback.
sophia: plan: try preserve-src where ENI cross-account supports it; otherwise enable per-tenant SNAT pools with port headroom metrics.
kai: port exhaustion is real. for SNAT pools we should autoscale ENIs when ephemeral ports >70% used and alert at 60%.
ops-bot: infra-check: prefix-filter-policy applied to canary-tenant-1 at 1711410200  no errors.
jordan: DNS plan: set TTL=30s during canary, start with 2% traffic, health-check for 5m, then 10m ramp windows.
sophia: rollout steps we need in runbook: attach connector, verify BGP filtered routes, validate src preservation/SNAT metrics, shift DNS weight, monitor 30m, rollback via withdraw routes + detach ENI. target rollback <15m.
kai: action items: jordan -> prefix-filter module; sophia -> runbook draft; ops -> schedule canary.
sophia: thanks all, i'll post the runbook link when ready.
